title: GetAssetCommand
description: Schema for Service Manager registry retrieval command OM3. This command is sent by the Orchestrator to the Service Manager to request the full representation of a specific Asset.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be getAssetCommand.

originator.description: Property. Component that generated the command.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the command was generated.

assetId.description: Relationship. Asset entity requested by the Orchestrator.
